paragraphs: Gravyty sells software for alumni engagement, mentoring, career opportunities and community building. The buyers are K-12 schools, nonprofits and higher education institutions raising money. The company describes its aim as rallying a community around a central mission through engagement, giving and stewardship tools.

The products are presented together as integrated solutions to recruit and retain a community. One piece answers student questions across communication channels in multiple languages. Another supplies branded alumni platforms for connection and mentoring, online and off. For giving there are mobile-first donation forms and branded giving sites meant to lift participation and recurring gifts. A video tool sends personalized messages to donors and supporters.

The stated audience spans the arc from applicant through enrolled student to participating alum. The company puts its reach at more than 2,000 engagement and fundraising teams. A homepage line invites institutions to join over 2,750 already using its AI. Athletic departments are called out separately, with tools tied to revenue sharing and alumni connections.
